Definition: the same as G4666; Smyrna, a place in Asia Minor:--Smyrna.
BiblicalUsage: Smyrna is one of the seven churches of Asia to which John is told to send what he sees. The letter to its angel comes from the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Smyrna matters because the Lord who died and lives again writes to a suffering church, and His being alive is their hope.
